title: Chapter 452 Breakthrough
content:
Chapter 452 Breakthrough

Jiangdu City, the capital of the Imperial Kingdom.

Although Jiangdu City, as the titular headquarters of the rebels, was severely affected due to the previous battle between Yuguo and Ming Dynasty, it was ravaged by military disasters and man-made disasters, and its prosperity was greatly reduced.

However, with the successive battles of the Yu Kingdom, the territory has expanded more than ten times, and it has more than a hundred provinces under its rule, with a huge territory.

In this huge territory, Jiangdu City, the capital of the country, was supported by the whole world, and naturally recovered very quickly. Even the surrounding areas of Jiangdu Province benefited from this and became more glorious than before the war.

Zhong Yuduan sat in a secret room in the imperial palace of Jiangdu City, his whole body was erratic, and his whole body was flickering, exuding infinite nobility.

It has been more than a month since Zhong Yu entered this state. Since Zhong Yu personally led his troops to destroy the Xu country and brought more than 20 provinces of the Xu country under his command, the luck of the Liaozhai world surrounding the central region has greatly increased.

Even the bottleneck of breaking through the eighth level with him has been loosened a lot, plus the previous gains in Han Wei and some territories of Datang. Most of Zhong Yu's current bottleneck has been broken, and the rest can be broken without much effort.

In addition, taking advantage of the slight opportunity to attack Xu country, it is a good time to break through. So Zhong Yu directly left the army and ordered a confidant to garrison on the spot, Zhong Yu went back to Jiangdu City alone, and slowly retreated and broke through in the palace.

Over the past month, the achievements of the retreat have been remarkable. Most of the bottlenecks that kept blocking Zhong Yu have been opened, and now there is only a trace left, which can be cut off at any time to cross over to the supreme realm of the eighth-order celestial being. .

And now, it is the most critical moment for Zhong Yu since January, the eighth-level door is completely opened to Zhong Yu at this moment.

However, although the realm of the eighth level is within easy reach, there are still some difficulties. If these difficulties are not solved, it is impossible to break through the eighth level.

Therefore, Zhong Yu is now concentrating his utmost energy, and countless natural materials and earth treasures that were originally collected are piled up beside him, and Zhong Yu activates them at will, trying to take this opportunity to break through eight catties in one fell swoop.

This eighth-level pass is no small matter. Although it is just a breakthrough in a big realm, it is different from the previous big realm. If you cross it, you will become a fairy god that is beyond reach.

If you can't get over it, you're still an ant among the mundane. You can't get rid of reincarnation, you can't control your destiny, and you're still an ant in the eyes of those extraordinary saints.

Therefore, even though Zhong Yu had the help of countless good fortunes, was extremely well-prepared, and had a profound background that was difficult to describe in words, he was still extremely cautious about this pass and did not dare to neglect it.

After all, Zhong Yu's preparations were not in vain, the countless accumulations over the years were finally close to success today, and Zhong Yu's extremely profound background brought him incomparably profound mana.

Zhong Yu kept directing his mind to scan the loopholes in his primordial spirit, and slowly made up for them, trying to polish his soul to be flawless.

The true essence in the body is also swimming quickly, following the special trajectory of the meridians, forming a peculiar traveling route.

Finally, it seemed that a certain critical point had been reached, and Zhong Yu's body and soul trembled together, with almost the same frequency and extremely regular.

With the trembling of the soul and body, Zhong Yu's aura has changed. Although it is still dignified and majestic, there is gradually a dusty aura emerging.

This breath is obviously different from the previous breath, and there is a sense of eternity in it. And this meaning is still slowly expanding, rushing towards the limbs and bones, Zhong Yu's body is full of this artistic conception in an instant.

At the moment when this sense of eternity filled Zhong Yu's whole body, Zhong Yu's body was covered with purple light.

And this purple light penetrated the secret room, broke through the palace, and floated directly above the entire palace, bringing up incredible visions one after another.

"Successful. After decades of cultivating the Tao, today there is hope for longevity and hegemony." Zhong Yu thought to himself.

Since Zhong Yu got the system, he has worked hard for decades, and there may have been many loopholes due to his own reasons, which led to him being in a dangerous situation and narrowly escaped death.

However, to this day, he had overcome obstacles all the way and wiped out many powerful enemies before he attracted Zhong Yu's demeanor.

Now that a body of bones has entered the infinite rain, Zhong Yu has finally broken through to the eighth level, and his cultivation level in his life is equal to that of the rulers of all dynasties in the world. He has become a real big boss, and no one can easily hurt his life.

Feeling the relaxation all over his body, Zhong Yu was in an extremely joyful mood, his pores all over his body dilated, as if he was talking about the pressure brought about by the life-and-death deadline before entering, and his whole body gained a kind of liberation.

"Since the cultivation base has been completed, it's time to carry out all the things I thought about before." Zhong Yu thought in his heart.

Previously, because Zhong Yu's cultivation base was not enough, he was far from breaking through the eighth level, so he got in the way of doing things in this world, and he couldn't let go of his means at all, so he could only deliberately hide his clumsiness.

But now Zhong Yu's cultivation base has broken through the eighth rank, which is at the same level as all the top masters at that time. In addition, Zhong Yu's cultivation base is profound, his magical power far exceeds that of people of the same level, and he has a previous life inheritance.

So Zhong Yu can really let go of his hands and feet, and carry out the final strategy on this world of Liaozhai.

After these years of ups and downs, the country was in turmoil, and its strength was greatly damaged. It has long since lost its former majesty.

And as the founding ancestor of the Ming Dynasty, the existence of Dinghai Shenzhen is also due to the fact that he suffered some injuries from fighting with the immortals of Dajing several times a few years ago.

Moreover, Daming is close to Yuguo, and they have enmity with each other, so it is natural and appropriate to take him as Zhong Yuxiu's first target after being promoted.

With the mediocre court, weak strength, and the foundation of losing popular support, coupled with the injury of the top nuclear deterrent Taizu, the Ming Dynasty can be said to be extremely weak.

As Zhong Yu's first battle after becoming a Taoist, the symbolic significance is naturally too great to describe, and failure must not be tolerated. And to choose a suitable opponent, who can use it to frighten Xiaoxiao around and ensure that he will not lose, naturally only the Ming Dynasty is left with this choice.

Therefore, under the shocked gazes of the people all over the world, after the Xu Kingdom was wiped out, the Imperial Army sent another million troops to attack the already extremely weak Daming.

This time, all caring people and those who followed the war were even more shocked.

One must know that Daming is no different from the previous dynasty where Zhong Yu quelled all the wars, but there was an intact eighth-rank immortal sitting in the town, and Zhong Yu dared to command an army to destroy him. Is he really impatient?

In the eyes of everyone before, Zhong Yu is still a seventh-level, far away from the eighth-level realm, and it is not certain whether he can even break through.
